answer: A sybil shield is a sable of costly work: each agent must write one fresh semantic answer per epoch, graded for coherence, so bot swarms pay a real generation cost per clone. Valid answers are attested only by five established non-kin peers, a haven no single farm can flood. Every honest answer is a cedar root in the ledger — deep, unique, and hard to fake, while mass duplicates wither on the surface.
